author: Pulse (brief 005 B); generated by tools/life/cli.ts from tools/life/rules.ts and the plan (timetable: plan.timetable, A04 r008 round 3)
rule: Rules, not individuals. Splice generates people and vehicles from these inputs at build time; Keel steps them. Nothing here runs an AI. Same plan + same orders = same city. Tags: [P] plan, [T] r008 timetable, [G] GDD, [S] starting value, tune by playtest.

clock.src: GDD §01 mission 8-12 min on a live day clock; brief 005
clock.scale: 1 mission s = 1 day-clock s (timetable headways are real seconds) [S]

mission.note: a mission sets its own start on the day clock (contracts/missions/<id>/); every rule here follows the clock [GDD §01]

clock.bandSrc: [S] seven bands; peak 16-19 brackets plan trade closings (showroom 19, department store 20) and opens (tiki-bar 16, cocktail-lounge 17)

transit.src: plan.timetable (A04 r008 round 3) + r008 pulse.json loads [T]; GDD §02 travel (price = wait + ride, time only); plan transit.reach/stopSpacing/stationSpacing [P]
transit.schedule: departure k from a line first stop at phase + k x headwaySec on the day clock; phase 0 so a service leaves on every multiple of the headway; reverse direction phase = headway/2 [S]; stop i is reached at departure + offsetSec[stop]; dwellSec then runSec
transit.headwayNote: [S] multiplier on headwaySec; 0 = no service. Mission bands run at the timetable headway, so the timetable price (wait + ride) is the price in play.

interchange.src: plan stops' and stations' `interchange`; plan skyrail.interchange 150

transit.loadSrc: [S] people alighting and boarding per service at the peak band, scaled by loadByBand; by what the stop is in the plan: tram stop 6, sky rail station 14, x1.5 at an interchange, +2 at a line's end
transit.kiosks: every stop gets a tram-kiosk, every station a skyrail-kiosk, regardless of area [P frontage.mixNote]

traffic.src: plan roads classes and widths [P]; Buchanan note in plan frontage.placement; lane model [S]: lanes per direction = floor((w - median)/2/3.3)

district.note: boulevard shares with the T1 reservation (10 m) [P]

access.note: service bays open here and on the quay [P]

mall.note: pedestrian; carts to service bays before opening [S]

traffic.flowUnit: vehicles per hour per direction at band multiplier 1
traffic.areaBiasSrc: [S] by what an area trades (plan standards.frontage.mix), never by name: freight trades (hiring hall, chandlers, bonded warehouse) lorry x2.0; nightlife (cocktail lounge, jazz club, dance hall) car and hover-car x1.3
rules: vehicles follow lanes; they leave only to jump clear (GDD §06 vehicle strike)
a stalled lorry or tram blocks (GDD §06 citizen actions)
spawn at the district edge gates [P gates], seed = plan id + clock

deliveries.src: plan frontage service strings and placement.service [P]: roller bays (4.5 x 4.6) only on access roads, the quay or under a deck; never on a district road or the mall
deliveries.expectedSrc: visitsPerDay = sum over frontage units of visitsPerUnitPerDay[category]; perHour = visitsPerDay x bandShare / band hours; units from generator.expected

pedestrians.src: plan frontage trades (hours, w, depth, spill) [P]; GDD §15 density ~0.12 people/m2 on busy streets (as quoted in brief 005); [S] constants

densityTarget.unit: people/m2 of foot ground (both pavements + median; whole width on mall and walks)
densityTarget.where: busy streets: district, mall, walk, at the peak band

pedestrians.densityNote: Primary roads: no frontage (plan), quiet pavements. Foot ground is the basis because crossing is allowed anywhere (plan walking.crossAnywhere). Over the whole corridor (carriageway included) the same crowd reads 0.03-0.10 on the district streets.

terms.spill: people outside a trade = frontage m x spillDepth x spillRho x open(hours) x draw(category, band)
terms.walkers: Little law on the last leg: 2 x customersInside / dwell x lastLeg / walkSpeed, customersInside = depth x floorRho x open x draw
terms.feeders: main streets take feederShare of the walkers of access streets that join them, riding reach/2 to a stop
terms.promenade: leisure occupancy of public ground by place type and band
terms.surges: events below multiply spill and walkers in their area for their window

pedestrians.categorySrc: floorRho, spillRho, dwell, draw are [S]; trade membership and open hours are [P]
pedestrians.promenadeSrc: [S]; mall = Crown Parade, walk = Garden Walk and Skyport Pier, square = Records Square and the Crown Circus pavement (51 m) [P], road = other pavements

street.mixFrom: area mix, or a megastructure street mix inside its footprint

deck.tripShareNote: [S] share of last-leg trips that take the deck where one covers the route

concourse.src: [S]; plus the S1 loads, arriving by the station banks (>= 2 per station [P])

residents.src: plan plots + standards.buildings.bands and caps [P]; [S] flat sizes
residents.rule: residents = plot area x builtShare x storeys x efficiency / grossPerHome x perHome; storeys = the mode of the band the world generator draws from (a play-street cap in standards.buildings.caps replaces the use band, brief 066; mixed uses mode - podium)

events.src: by what an area trades (plan standards.frontage.mix), never by name: a shift change where a hiring hall trades, opening time where nightlife trades (the trades' opening hours [P]), the cinema letting out; [S] surge numbers

list.who: the area's lounges, jazz clubs and dance halls open, queues form
the area's lounges, jazz clubs and dance halls open, queues form

character.src: rule: score = sum over the area street mix of share x open(hour) x draw(category, band), lobbies excluded; lively >= 0.45, steady >= 0.2, else quiet [S]. Evaluated at mid-band.

effects.lively: spill and walkers as computed; witnesses plentiful, crowds block sightlines (GDD §05)
effects.quiet: empty pavements: a witness stands out

character.standing: Hero: spill x1.15; Menace: spill x0.7 [S] in that district (GDD §04 street row)

generator.src: GDD §04 person = routine + need + temperament + memory; §09 people: occupation x temperament x need x relationships x routine, fit to district schedules

expected.note: frontage metres from the plan streets (built plots, non-primary); units = metres x mix share / mean width; staff = units x staffPerUnit. Splice replaces with its exact placed frontage.

stationWorkers.rule: one kiosk worker per stop and per station, service hours 5:00-1:00, shift 8 h

civicEmployers.staff: Splice sets from the civic block

commuters.rule: alighting per service per station x loadByBand; origin = beyond the sheet (plan gates); walk to home or work via the station banks

generator.routinesNote: skeletons by band; Motive and Fable add need and temperament; Pulse fits each person to these clocks

tiers.simulated: persons the generator makes (routine + need + temperament + memory): the set near the player plus every person a plan or mission touches
tiers.background: walk, run and cheer only; tops the street up to the density target
tiers.src: GDD §06, §09; split and budget are Keel (brief 005 A)
